title: cap-table inputs.json
description: Founder-supplied + extracted engagement inputs. AoA extraction populates the `preferred_series` array + `aoa_findings` block. Founders block carries common-share holdings; option_pool carries existing pool sizing.

common_batches.description: Issued common-share batches beyond the founders block.

holder_name.description: Optional human-readable shareholder name; shown in the ownership tables when present, else the batch falls back to holder_id.

preferred_series.description: Preferred-stock series. v0.5.0 removes dividend_rate_percent + dividend_cumulative (E_DIVIDEND_FIELDS_REMOVED if present); dividend provisions surface via aoa_findings.dividend_provisions_present for counsel-handoff.

ad_carve_outs.description: Scalar policy marker despite the plural name — only one carve-out bundle (NVCA-default) is modeled today. Accepts the canonical scalar 'nvca_default' plus the two list shapes the plural name invites a model to write ([] and ['nvca_default']); cap_state.py normalizes all three to the scalar 'nvca_default'. Any other value is rejected.

pricing_unknown.description: True when the founder/mapper could not confirm this series' actual issue/conversion pricing. When true, original_issue_price/original_conversion_price/current_conversion_price are written as a numeric 1.0 sentinel (NOT real pricing) and anti_dilution_protection must resolve to 'none' — cap_state.py enforces both post-canonicalization. Declared here for documentation only; the hand-rolled runtime validator does not support if/then, so this flag drives no schema-level branching.

aoa_findings.description: Source of truth for AoA-extracted findings. cap_state.py mirrors these into cap_state.aoa_findings (read-only mirror; never dual-written).

stage.description: Founder-declared funding stage, same vocabulary as founder_context.py --stage. Optional, and deliberately has no default: stage-scoped benchmarks must be able to tell 'not recorded' from a stage, and must not fire on the former. Absent means a stage-scoped rule does not apply rather than applying at some assumed stage.

cap_base_source.description: Whether the founder cap base (founders + share counts + pool) was founder-confirmed ('confirmed') or assumed/placeholder ('assumed'). Drives the S2 W_CAP_BASE_ASSUMED backstop; absent is treated as not-confirmed but only warns on a positive signal (placeholder names).

cap_base_provenance.description: How the cap base was produced (lineage), distinct from whether it was confirmed. The freeform mapper stamps 'deterministic_mapped' when it produces the equity from the spreadsheet; a Lane-1/2/4 hand-build sets 'model_reconstructed' (or leaves it absent). cap_state emits W_CAP_BASE_RECONSTRUCTED when a 'confirmed' base is NOT 'deterministic_mapped' — so a model-built base can't masquerade as verified. Free string (no enum) so a model-set value never fails validation; the trigger keys on the absence of the exact 'deterministic_mapped' marker.

extraction_mode.description: How the source was read. Set to 'vision_image_pdf' when the pdf-probe detects an image-only PDF (no text layer) read by raw model vision (no OCR) — cap_state then emits W_VISION_EXTRACTION_LOW_CONFIDENCE so the structured artifacts carry the under-extraction caveat. Free string; the trigger keys on the exact 'vision_image_pdf' value.

source_markup.description: Revision state of the source document. Set to 'tracked_changes_accepted' when the founder chose to proceed on the accepted-revisions (final-proposed) view of a redline/tracked-changes .docx — cap_state then emits W_REDLINE_DRAFT so the report persists the unsigned-draft caveat. Free string (no enum, so a model-set value never fails validation); the trigger keys on the exact 'tracked_changes_accepted' value.

stated_totals.description: Independent totals the SOURCE document itself prints (e.g. Carta's 'Totals' row fully-diluted figure), captured to cross-foot against the computed cap state. cap_state compares fully_diluted to as_converted_totals.fully_diluted_shares and emits a suppressible W_FD_RECONCILE_DELTA when they diverge beyond 0.1%. Optional; populate ONLY from a total the source prints independently of the entered holder/class rows (so the check is non-circular).

fully_diluted.description: Fully-diluted share total the SOURCE document prints (e.g. Carta's 'Totals' row). Cross-footed against the computed as_converted_totals.fully_diluted_shares. Source-printed only (non-circular).

price_per_share.description: Per-share price the SOURCE document prints for the round (e.g. a pro-forma's stated PPS). Captured to reconcile against the skill's computed equity_financing_price. Source-printed only (non-circular).

pre_money.description: Pre-money valuation the SOURCE document prints for the round. Reconciled against the pre_money used in the scenario. Source-printed only (non-circular).

acquisition.description: Negotiated-% acquisition whose holders receive consideration shares in/around the priced round.
